<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
$items = array(
	array( 'Classic Leather Wallet', '49', 'WALLET-01' ),
	array( 'Canvas Weekend Bag', '129', 'BAG-02' ),
	array( 'Ceramic Pour-Over Set', '64', 'POUR-03' ),
	array( 'Merino Wool Beanie', '35', 'BEANIE-04' ),
);
foreach ( $items as $item ) {
	$p = new WC_Product_Simple();
	$p->set_name( $item[0] );
	$p->set_regular_price( $item[1] );
	$p->set_sku( $item[2] );
	$p->set_status( 'publish' );
	$p->save();
}
$page_id = wp_insert_post( array(
	'post_type'    => 'page',
	'post_title'   => 'Wishlist',
	'post_name'    => 'wishlist',
	'post_status'  => 'publish',
	'post_content' => '[jvm_woocommerce_wishlist]',
) );
$settings = get_option( 'cixwishlist_settings' );
if ( ! is_array( $settings ) ) {
	$settings = array();
}
$settings['wishlist_page'] = $page_id;
update_option( 'cixwishlist_settings', $settings );
